These links describe the development branch (`main`). Releases are installed from tags, never
from `main`, so match documentation to the version you installed: for the package catalogs and
examples, replace `main` in the URL with the installed tag (for example `v1.2.0`); for the API
reference, select that version in the reference itself; for audits, always use the current index
below — reports are published after releases, and each row names the commit and scope it covers.

## Start here

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/{{repo}}/main/README.md): overview,
  installation and usage
- [ARCHITECTURE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/{{repo}}/main/ARCHITECTURE.md):
  design decisions and constraints
- [GUIDELINES.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/OpenZeppelin/{{repo}}/main/GUIDELINES.md):
  coding conventions for contributors
